jobs.description: List of scheduled cron jobs. Each entry defines a task to run at a specified time under a specific user.

minute.description: Minute of the hour (0–59), '*' for any, or a range/list (e.g., '0,30', '1-5')

hour.description: Hour of the day (0–23), '*' for any, or range/list

day.description: Day of the month (1–31), '*' for any

month.description: Month of the year (1–12), '*' for any

dow.description: Day of the week (0–7, where 0 and 7 = Sunday), '*' for any

user.description: System user to run the command as (required)

comment.description: Optional human-readable description for the job (rendered as comment above the line)
